pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

4. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   C. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.

5. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

6. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Handball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   D. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. C — The speed of the music

3. A — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. D — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
